'''Lumica''' was the capital city of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]]. After the planet was [[Battle of Argul|attacked]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] began an evacuation of the city.
